caveats: test execution evidence is process evidence only
skipped and xfailed tests are not counted as passed authority
scientific status is not inferred from this receipt

config_values.markers:
smoke: small deterministic harness and package reachability checks; not scientific validation
fast: quick tests suitable for local pre-commit subsets
slow: marks tests as slow / end-to-end integration; run explicitly with '-m slow'
requires_healpy: tests requiring optional dependency healpy; skip must name healpy when unavailable
requires_dynesty: tests requiring optional dependency dynesty; skip must name dynesty when unavailable
anchor: numerical regression anchors; does not by itself certify production readiness
verification: v5 design-pack verification bundle checks
ci: fast subset safe to run on every CI push
